'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Bill Kafer DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Blame It On Bad Luck
* '''Username:''' TacoBill
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
